raw_segments.text: And Jove said, Juno, you can choose some other time for paying your visit to Oceanus, for
the present let us devote ourselves to love and to the enjoyment of one another.
Never yet have I been so overpowered by passion neither for goddess nor mortal woman as I
am at this moment for yourself, not even when I was in love with the wife of Ixion who bore
me Pyrithus, peer of gods and counsel, nor yet with Dany, the daintily-anchored daughter
of Echrisius, who bore me the famed hero Perseus.
Then there was the daughter of Phoenix, who bore me Minus and Radimanthes.
There was Semele, and Alcmina and Thebes by whom I begot my lion-hearted son Hercules,
while Semele became mother to Bacchus the Comforter of Mankind.
There was Queen Ceres again, and lovely Leto and yourself, but with none of these was I ever
so much enamored as I now am with you.
